title.en: Styling is placed in the stylesheet, not the markup

summary.en: A style attribute or a <style> element in markup mixes presentation into structure; the declarations belong in a stylesheet.

en: Some styling was about to be mixed into a page.
I am moving it to the stylesheet, which is easier to change later.
fr: Du style allait être mélangé à une page.
Je le mets dans le fichier de style, c'est plus facile à modifier ensuite.

reason.en: Styling was found mixed into markup: a style attribute, or a <style> element in a page. Move the declarations into a stylesheet and reference it, so structure and presentation stay separate and the page stays easy to change. A style attribute within an <svg> subtree and a small <style data-critical> block are left alone.
